g.text: A PID loop acts through bounded hardware on a process with lag and dead time
Plot is the open-loop FOPDT response to a unit input step, not a claimed closed-loop PID response. Process gain2, dead time2 min,time constant5 min.
Hardware saturation limits controller output; integral action needs suitable anti-windup. Sensor/actuator dynamics and nonlinearities may require a richer
